milestones.description: One real actor, safely: an actor defined in config runs through Claude Code on a worktree, and you keep or discard its work. Installed with uv
Config by hand: edits made to troupe’s files by hand are read back into config, and entities can be renamed
Gates: a run stops for approval before its work is kept; every gate is manual, and the approver is whoever runs troupe
A sequence: actors run one after another, with gates between them
Escalations: an actor that can’t decide researches, then asks with a brief, so not everything needs a gate
Roles: people, their identities and the roles they hold; gates and escalations reach a role, for selective approval
In parallel: flows fork into tasks that run at once, and join again
Notes: what a run teaches feeds into the next
The house: runs outlive the terminal that started them, with live status
The web UI: non-technical users run workflows in a browser, installed without the command line
Loops: part of a flow repeats until a condition holds, such as a gate passing
Swarms: many actors work on one task, and their results are compared or combined
Contained: a Docker stage enforces each actor’s declared effects
Other runners: an actor runs on a local model through its engine’s own API, or on any OpenAI-style API, without Claude Code
Plugins over JSON-RPC: a generic bridge, and an SDK for writing plugins in Python
Policy: policy files with levels that can only tighten, including which plugin transports are allowed
Plugins from elsewhere: config names and pins plugins and guests, and troupe acquires them
Work tracking: troupe reads and updates work in a tracker, GitHub first
Together: approvals travel between installs
Telemetry: asked for, and inspectable
The first stable release: the stability promise for the protocol, config and recorded data
